summary: Implemented prepareUpdate and the Update container. Changes: Update class in rdflib/plugins/sparql/sparql.py; translateUpdate in algebra.py now always returns Update(prologue, algebra), with the empty-request path using translatePrologue([], base, initNs); evalUpdate in update.py iterates update.algebra; prepareUpdate added to processor.py and exported from sparql/__init__.py; new test module test/test_sparql_prepared_update.py. Nothing was run (per instructions), so the new tests and existing DAWG/prepareQuery tests are unverified. The no-mutation test uses repr snapshot of algebra. The initBindings test assumes an empty WHERE group yields one solution carrying the bindings. Nothing committed.
